$comment: Every option the field takes, grouped as the field lab groups them. The README table and the Storybook controls are built from this file; pnpm stateline:test fails if an engine option is missing. Ranges are the field lab's.

options.label: Style
options.about: What the line does as you type. follow: a swell rides the caret. wave: a ripple that runs forward. cloud: bumps all round.

options.label: Swell
options.about: Height of the swell over the caret, px.

options.label: Swell width
options.about: Width of the swell, px.

options.label: Key nudge
options.about: Extra push each keystroke gives the swell, px.

options.label: Catch-up
options.about: How quickly the swell catches the caret. 1 is instant.

options.label: Jiggle
options.about: jiggle: how hard each keystroke shakes the line, px.

options.label: Ripple size
options.about: ripple and wave: height of each ripple, px.

options.label: Ripple speed
options.about: ripple and wave: how fast ripples travel, px/s.

options.label: Ripple direction
options.about: ripple: spread both ways from the caret, or only forward (what wave does).

options.label: Cloud bump size
options.about: cloud: width of each bump, px.

options.label: Cloud height
options.about: cloud: height of the bumps at rest, px.

options.label: Cloud nudge
options.about: cloud: extra puff each keystroke gives, px.

options.label: Style
options.about: What the line does while it sends. orbit: one wave circles the field.

options.label: Wave height
options.about: Height of the sending wave, px.

options.label: Wavelength
options.about: Length of one wave, px.

options.label: Wave speed
options.about: wave: how fast it travels, px/s.

options.label: Orbit length
options.about: orbit: share of the outline the wave covers, 0 to 1.

options.label: Orbit lap (s)
options.about: orbit: seconds per lap.

options.label: Spinner length
options.about: spinner: share of the outline the stroke covers.

options.label: Spinner laps/s
options.about: spinner: laps a second.

options.label: Style
options.about: How a wrong value lands. drawn: a hand-drawn jag that hits and settles smaller. spring: overshoots and settles.

options.label: Teeth size
options.about: jagged and spring: height of the teeth, px.

options.label: Teeth spacing
options.about: Distance between teeth, px.

options.label: Drawn hit
options.about: drawn: teeth height as the error lands, px.

options.label: Drawn settled
options.about: drawn: teeth height once it settles, px.

options.label: Drawn settle (s)
options.about: drawn: seconds from hit to settled.

options.label: Spring rate
options.about: spring: how fast the teeth spring.

options.label: Spring bounce
options.about: spring: how much they overshoot.

options.label: Pulse size
options.about: pulse: how far the line pulses out, px.

options.label: Pulses/s
options.about: pulse: pulses a second.

options.label: Error swell
options.about: How far the whole border swells when an error lands, then springs back, px.

options.label: Soften on edit
options.about: Editing after an error drops the teeth but keeps the line red until the value is valid.

options.label: Shake
options.about: Shake the form when an error lands.

options.label: Style
options.about: What happens once it's sent. pieces: the outline flies apart and draws back. ticks: it turns into ticks and closes. both: sunburst and confetti.

options.label: Piece length
options.about: pieces: length of each piece, px.

options.label: Pieces fly
options.about: pieces: how far they fly out, px.

options.label: Pieces fall
options.about: pieces: how far they drop, px.

options.label: Pieces spin
options.about: pieces: degrees each one turns.

options.label: Pieces time (s)
options.about: pieces: seconds in the air.

options.label: Redraw at (s)
options.about: pieces: when the outline starts drawing back.

options.label: Ticks hold (s)
options.about: ticks: seconds the ticks hold before closing.

options.label: Ticks drift
options.about: ticks: how far they drift, px.

options.label: Ray length
options.about: sunburst: length of each ray, px.

options.label: Ray spacing
options.about: sunburst: distance between rays, px.

options.label: Confetti spacing
options.about: confetti: distance between pieces, px.

options.label: Settle
options.about: How far the outline breathes out and back once it's whole again, px.

options.label: Stroke
options.about: Line width, px.

options.label: Corner radius
options.about: Corner radius, px.

options.label: Focus stroke
options.about: Added to the line width while the field has focus, px. 0 turns it off.

options.label: Uniformity
options.about: 1: every tooth, bump and piece alike. 0: hand-drawn.

options.label: Handover (s)
options.about: Roughly how long the last state's shape takes to spring away.

options.label: Handover bounce
options.about: How much it overshoots on the way out.

options.label: Beat (s)
options.about: A beat before a new state starts.

options.label: Stiffness
options.about: How hard the state shapes pull toward their target.

options.label: Damping
options.about: How quickly they stop wobbling.
